# AP News

> > Breaking news and investigative reporting from The Associated Press covering crime, justice, politics, and human interest stories across America.

AP News is the digital home of The Associated Press, one of the world's most trusted sources for independent journalism. This collection features regional and national coverage with emphasis on criminal justice, legal proceedings, political campaigns, and cultural stories from across the United States.

## Key Topics

- Criminal Justice & Legal System
- Death Penalty Cases
- Texas Crime Reporting
- Nebraska Supreme Court
- DNA Testing & Inmates Rights
- Homicide Investigations
- Teen Victims
- Malcolm X & Civil Rights
- Nebraska Hall of Fame
- Political Campaigns & Governor Races
- Supreme Court Rulings
- Law Enforcement
- Federal Regulatory Decisions
- Capital Punishment Appeals
